security.name: First Majestic Silver Corp. 0.125% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031
security.conversion_right: Holder may convert at any time until close of business on the business day immediately preceding 2031-01-15, subject to the indenture.
security.optional_redemption_condition: Closing Sale Price exceeds 130% of the conversion price on at least 20 trading days in a 30-consecutive-trading-day period ending before redemption notice.
security.optional_redemption_price: 100% of principal plus accrued and unpaid interest to (but excluding) redemption date.
security.fundamental_change_put: Holder may require repurchase at 100% of principal plus accrued and unpaid interest to (but excluding) purchase date.
security.coupon_dates_source_note: Interest payments January 15 and July 15; first stated payment July 15, 2026. Remaining regular coupons generated from the valuation date.
security.underlying_spot_source: First Majestic investor stock-information page; NYSE close, USD.

market_inputs.market_data_status: ILLUSTRATIVE PLACEHOLDERS — replace with Bloomberg market data before using for valuation or BRM testing.
